name: Maceió
scopeLimits: The public map is interactive but the inspected backing API requires parcel inscription or sector/quadra and does not expose a documented safe field allowlist. No broad query was made and no geometry was retained. City registry/map existence does not establish public anonymous polygon access at the WUP point.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The city’s public service says users can search urban municipal tax registration from a map, and IPLAM describes the municipal technical cadastre. IPLAM states editable cadastral cartography (including Shapefile/DWG) is restricted to institutional partner agencies.
technicalBlocker: Inspected the official interactive viewer and its publicly linked loader/search scripts. The integration endpoint accepts parcel inscription or sector/quadra and its response includes address-related fields without a documented field-selection parameter. No property key, address or broad geometry request was submitted.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the map service can support safe anonymous geometry queries at this exact point remains unknown. The citywide Quadras layer was not queried because that would be an unbounded extraction.
nextStep: Root review; seek a documented public feature service with a safe attribute allowlist or city-issued coverage response.
